```python
def _flatten_policy(prefix: str, value: Any) -> list[tuple[str, Any]]:
    """Flatten a nested TOML dict into stable dot-path key/value pairs."""
    items: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in sorted(value):
            next_prefix = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else key
            items.extend(_flatten_policy(next_prefix, value[key]))
    else:
        items.append((prefix, value))
    return items


def _render_universal_minimal(policy: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:
    """Render the universal policy as a compact, lossless minimal packet.

    Includes every key from universal.toml and every HARD behavioural directive.
    Strips prose, examples, markdown, and duplicated statements.
    """
    if policy is None:
        policy = _load_toml(REGISTRY_DIR / "universal.toml")

    lines: list[str] = ["CDSFL_CORE_MINIMAL"]
    seen: set[str] = set(lines)

    for key, value in _flatten_policy("", policy):
        rendered_value = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        line = f"{key}={rendered_value}"
        if line not in seen:
            lines.append(line)
            seen.add(line)

    for directive in HARD_BEHAVIOURAL_DIRECTIVES:
        if directive not in seen:
            lines.append(directive)
            seen.add(directive)

    rendered = "\n".join(lines)
    if len(rendered) > 4000:
        raise PolicyViolationError(
            f"Minimal universal rendering is still too large ({len(rendered)} chars)."
        )
    return rendered


def _load_universal_directive(model: str | None = None) -> DirectivePacket:
    """Load the universal CDSFL directive, using minimal rendering when needed."""
    formal_path = DIRECTIVES_DIR / "universal" / "cdsfl_core_formal.md"
    prose_path = DIRECTIVES_DIR / "universal" / "cdsfl_core.txt"
    path = formal_path if formal_path.exists() else prose_path
    full_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

    if model is None:
        text = full_text
    else:
        transform = PHENOTYPE_TRANSFORMS.get(model, PhenotypeTransform())
        text = (
            _render_universal_minimal()
            if len(full_text) > transform.max_directive_chars
            else full_text
        )

    return DirectivePacket(
        layer="universal",
        name="cdsfl_core",
        text=text,
        constraint_class="HARD",
        tags={"falsification", "hard_soft", "anti_deference", "verification"},
    )
```

```python
def _intra_packet_prune(packet: DirectivePacket, char_budget: int) -> DirectivePacket:
    """Prune individual SOFT directives inside a packet while preserving HARD ones."""
    import re

    if len(packet.text) <= char_budget:
        return packet

    directive_start_re = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:\d+[.)]|[-*])\s+")
    heading_re = re.compile(r"^\s*\[(.+?)\]\s*$")

    def classify_heading(heading: str) -> str | None:
        lower = heading.lower()
        if "hard" in lower and "constraint" in lower:
            return "HARD"
        if "soft" in lower and "constraint" in lower:
            return "SOFT"
        return None

    def is_hard_text(text: str, heading_mode: str | None) -> bool:
        lower = text.lower()
        if heading_mode == "HARD":
            return True
        hard_markers = (
            "hard constraint",
            "non-negotiable",
            "mandatory",
            "required",
            "must not",
            "must never",
            "prohibited",
            "forbidden",
            "never ",
            "shall ",
            "always ",
        )
        return any(marker in lower for marker in hard_markers)

    preamble: list[str] = []
    units: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    current_lines: list[str] = []
    current_heading = ""
    current_mode: str | None = None
    saw_directive = False

    def flush_current() -> None:
        nonlocal current_lines
        if not current_lines:
            return
        body = "\n".join(current_lines).strip()
        current_lines = []
        if not body:
            return
        units.append(
            {
                "heading": current_heading,
                "body": body,
                "is_hard": is_hard_text(body, current_mode),
            }
        )

    for raw_line in packet.text.splitlines():
        stripped = raw_line.strip()

        heading_match = heading_re.match(stripped)
        if heading_match:
            flush_current()
            current_heading = f"[{heading_match.group(1)}]"
            current_mode = classify_heading(current_heading) or current_mode
            if not saw_directive:
                preamble.append(current_heading)
            continue

        if directive_start_re.match(stripped):
            flush_current()
            current_lines = [raw_line]
            saw_directive = True
            continue

        if current_lines:
            current_lines.append(raw_line)
        else:
            preamble.append(raw_line)

    flush_current()

    if not units:
        paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", packet.text) if p.strip()]
        units = [
            {"heading": "", "body": paragraph, "is_hard": is_hard_text(paragraph, None)}
            for paragraph in paragraphs
        ]
        preamble = []

    def rebuild(selected_flags: list[bool]) -> str:
        chunks: list[str] = []
        preamble_text = "\n".join(line for line in preamble if line.strip()).strip()
        if preamble_text:
            chunks.append(preamble_text)

        last_heading: str | None = None
        for keep, unit in zip(selected_flags, units):
            if not keep:
                continue
            heading = unit["heading"]
            if heading and heading != last_heading:
                chunks.append(heading)
                last_heading = heading
            chunks.append(unit["body"])

        return "\n\n".join(chunk for chunk in chunks if chunk).strip()

    selected = [True] * len(units)

    for idx in range(len(units) - 1, -1, -1):
        current_text = rebuild(selected)
        if len(current_text) <= char_budget:
            break
        if not units[idx]["is_hard"]:
            selected[idx] = False

    rebuilt = rebuild(selected)

    if len(rebuilt) > char_budget:
        selected = [unit["is_hard"] for unit in units]
        rebuilt = rebuild(selected)

    return DirectivePacket(
        layer=packet.layer,
        name=packet.name,
        text=rebuilt,
        constraint_class=packet.constraint_class,
        domain=packet.domain,
        model=packet.model,
        tags=set(packet.tags) | ({"intra_pruned"} if rebuilt != packet.text else set()),
    )
```

```python
def _apply_phenotype_transform(text: str, transform: PhenotypeTransform) -> str:
    """Apply phenotype rendering rules with header flattening, line collapsing,
    and intra-packet deduplication."""
    import re
    from difflib import SequenceMatcher

    if not text or not text.strip():
        return text

    def strip_blocks(lines: list[str], starters: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
        filtered: list[str] = []
        skipping = False
        for line in lines:
            stripped = line.strip().lower()
            if any(stripped.startswith(prefix) for prefix in starters):
                skipping = True
                continue
            if skipping and (
                not stripped
                or stripped.startswith("#")
                or stripped.startswith("[")
                or stripped.startswith("===")
                or re.match(r"^\d+[.)]\s", stripped)
                or re.match(r"^[-*]\s", stripped)
            ):
                skipping = False
            if not skipping:
                filtered.append(line)
        return filtered

    def compress_tables(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        filtered: list[str] = []
        for line in lines:
            stripped = line.strip()
            if "|" in stripped and stripped.startswith("|"):
                cells = [cell.strip() for cell in stripped.split("|") if cell.strip()]
                if cells and not all(set(cell) <= {"-"} for cell in cells):
                    filtered.append("; ".join(cells))
            else:
                filtered.append(line)
        return filtered

    def normalise_header(line: str) -> str | None:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            return ""
        if re.match(r"^[-=]{3,}$", stripped):
            return None
        if re.match(r"^#{1,6}\s+", stripped):
            label = re.sub(r"^#{1,6}\s+", "", stripped).strip(" :")
            return f"{label}:"
        return stripped

    def split_units(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        units: list[str] = []
        current: list[str] = []
        for line in lines:
            if line == "":
                if current:
                    units.append(" ".join(current).strip())
                    current = []
                continue
            if re.match(r"^(?:\d+[.)]|[-*])\s+", line):
                if current:
                    units.append(" ".join(current).strip())
                current = [line]
                continue
            if line.endswith(":") and current:
                units.append(" ".join(current).strip())
                current = [line]
                continue
            current.append(line)
        if current:
            units.append(" ".join(current).strip())
        return [unit for unit in units if unit]

    def canonicalise(unit: str) -> str:
        lower = unit.lower()
        synonym_map = {
            "detailed": "detail",
            "verbose": "detail",
            "exhaustive": "detail",
            "proofs": "proof",
            "prove": "proof",
            "examples": "example",
            "minimal": "minimal",
            "concise": "minimal",
            "brief": "minimal",
            "terse": "minimal",
            "headers": "header",
            "markdown": "format",
            "tables": "table",
            "rationale": "reason",
            "motivation": "reason",
            "why": "reason",
        }
        for src, dst in synonym_map.items():
            lower = lower.replace(src, dst)
        tokens = [
            token
            for token in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", lower)
            if token
            not in {
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "to",
                "of",
                "for",
                "with",
                "use",
                "prefer",
                "provide",
                "be",
                "is",
                "are",
                "must",
                "should",
                "that",
            }
        ]
        return " ".join(sorted(set(tokens)))

    lines = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")

    if transform.strip_examples:
        lines = strip_blocks(lines, ("example:", "examples:", "e.g.,", "for example:", "for instance:"))
    if transform.strip_rationale:
        lines = strip_blocks(lines, ("why:", "rationale:", "motivation:", "reason:", "background:", "context:"))
    if transform.compress_tables:
        lines = compress_tables(lines)

    flattened_lines: list[str] = []
    for line in lines:
        normalised = normalise_header(line)
        if normalised is not None:
            flattened_lines.append(normalised)

    units = split_units(flattened_lines)

    deduped: list[str] = []
    seen_keys: list[str] = []
    for unit in units:
        collapsed = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", unit).strip()
        if not collapsed:
            continue
        key = canonicalise(collapsed)
        if any(
            key == seen
            or SequenceMatcher(None, key, seen).ratio() >= 0.92
            for seen in seen_keys
        ):
            continue
        seen_keys.append(key)
        deduped.append(collapsed)

    separator = "\n\n" if transform.format_style == "full" else "\n"
    rendered = separator.join(deduped).strip()

    while deduped and len(rendered) > transform.max_directive_chars:
        deduped.pop()
        rendered = separator.join(deduped).strip()

    if len(rendered) > transform.max_directive_chars:
        rendered = rendered[: transform.max_directive_chars].rstrip()

    return rendered
```

```python
def resolve_layer_conflicts(composed: ComposedDirectiveSet) -> ComposedDirectiveSet:
    """Resolve universal/domain/phenotype/situation conflicts and log decisions."""
    import copy
    import re

    layer_priority = {
        "universal": 4,
        "domain": 3,
        "phenotype": 2,
        "situation": 1,
    }

    def phenotype_packet() -> DirectivePacket | None:
        phenotype = composed.manifest.get("phenotype_transform", {})
        clauses: list[str] = []

        format_style = phenotype.get("format_style")
        if format_style == "minimal":
            clauses.append("Use minimal format.")
        elif format_style == "concise":
            clauses.append("Use concise format.")

        if phenotype.get("strip_examples"):
            clauses.append("Do not include examples.")
        if phenotype.get("strip_rationale"):
            clauses.append("Do not include rationale.")
        if phenotype.get("compress_tables"):
            clauses.append("Do not use markdown tables.")

        if not clauses:
            return None

        return DirectivePacket(
            layer="phenotype",
            name="phenotype_transform",
            text="\n".join(clauses),
            constraint_class="SOFT",
            model=composed.manifest.get("model"),
            tags={"phenotype"},
        )

    def split_clauses(text: str) -> list[str]:
        chunks = re.split(r"\n\s*\n|(?m)^\s*(?=\d+[.)]\s|[-*]\s)", text)
        return [chunk.strip() for chunk in chunks if chunk.strip()]

    def classify_axis(clause: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
        lower = clause.lower()

        if any(term in lower for term in ("detailed proof", "detailed mathematical proof", "full proof", "step-by-step proof", "exhaustive")):
            return "detail", "high"
        if any(term in lower for term in ("minimal format", "concise format", "brief output", "terse output", "minimal prompt")):
            return "detail", "low"

        if "example" in lower and any(term in lower for term in ("do not", "omit", "without", "strip", "remove")):
            return "examples", "no"
        if "example" in lower:
            return "examples", "yes"

        if any(term in lower for term in ("do not include rationale", "strip rationale", "omit rationale")):
            return "rationale", "no"
        if any(term in lower for term in ("include rationale", "explain why", "give rationale", "show reasoning")):
            return "rationale", "yes"

        if any(term in lower for term in ("no markdown", "plain text", "do not use markdown tables", "remove markdown headers")):
            return "format", "plain"
        if any(term in lower for term in ("markdown table", "section header", "use markdown")):
            return "format", "rich"

        return None, None

    def specificity(packet: DirectivePacket, clause: str) -> int:
        score = 0
        if packet.layer == "domain":
            score += 2
        if packet.domain:
            score += 1
        if re.search(r"\b(mathematical|security|structural|software|hardware|clinical)\b", clause.lower()):
            score += 1
        return score

    candidate_packets = list(composed.packets)
    synthetic_phenotype = phenotype_packet()
    if synthetic_phenotype is not None:
        candidate_packets.append(synthetic_phenotype)

    packet_clauses: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    conflicts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for packet_index, packet in enumerate(candidate_packets):
        clause_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for clause_index, clause in enumerate(split_clauses(packet.text)):
            axis, value = classify_axis(clause)
            clause_records.append(
                {
                    "packet_index": packet_index,
                    "clause_index": clause_index,
                    "text": clause,
                    "axis": axis,
                    "value": value,
                    "layer": packet.layer,
                    "is_hard": packet.constraint_class == "HARD",
                    "priority": layer_priority.get(packet.layer, 0),
                    "specificity": specificity(packet, clause),
                }
            )
        packet_clauses[packet_index] = clause_records

    keep_ids: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
    axis_groups: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}

    for clause_records in packet_clauses.values():
        for record in clause_records:
            record_id = (record["packet_index"], record["clause_index"])
            if record["axis"] is None:
                keep_ids.add(record_id)
            else:
                axis_groups.setdefault(record["axis"], []).append(record)

    for axis, records in axis_groups.items():
        values = {record["value"] for record in records}
        if len(values) <= 1:
            for record in records:
                keep_ids.add((record["packet_index"], record["clause_index"]))
            continue

        hard_records = [record for record in records if record["is_hard"]]
        pool = hard_records if hard_records else records
        winner = max(
            pool,
            key=lambda record: (
                record["priority"],
                record["specificity"],
                len(record["text"]),
            ),
        )
        winning_value = winner["value"]

        for record in records:
            record_id = (record["packet_index"], record["clause_index"])
            if record["value"] == winning_value and (
                hard_records == [] or record["is_hard"]
            ):
                keep_ids.add(record_id)
            else:
                conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "axis": axis,
                        "winner_layer": winner["layer"],
                        "winner_text": winner["text"],
                        "loser_layer": record["layer"],
                        "loser_text": record["text"],
                        "winner_value": winning_value,
                        "loser_value": record["value"],
                    }
                )

    resolved_packets: list[DirectivePacket] = []
    for packet_index, packet in enumerate(composed.packets):
        clauses = packet_clauses.get(packet_index, [])
        kept_text = "\n\n".join(
            record["text"]
            for record in clauses
            if (record["packet_index"], record["clause_index"]) in keep_ids
        ).strip()
        resolved_packets.append(
            DirectivePacket(
                layer=packet.layer,
                name=packet.name,
                text=kept_text or packet.text,
                constraint_class=packet.constraint_class,
                domain=packet.domain,
                model=packet.model,
                tags=set(packet.tags),
            )
        )

    rendered = _render_directive_text(resolved_packets)
    token_estimate = max(len(rendered) // 4, 1)
    density = composed.constraint_count / token_estimate
    cid = _compute_cid(resolved_packets, composed.manifest["model"])

    manifest = copy.deepcopy(composed.manifest)
    manifest["cid"] = cid
    manifest["conflicts"] = conflicts

    return ComposedDirectiveSet(
        packets=resolved_packets,
        rendered_text=rendered,
        policy=composed.policy,
        cid=cid,
        constraint_count=composed.constraint_count,
        token_estimate=token_estimate,
        constraint_density=density,
        coherence_budget=composed.coherence_budget,
        pruned_soft=list(composed.pruned_soft),
        manifest=manifest,
    )
```

```python
def calibrate_coherence_budgets(
    log_inputs: list[Path | dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    chars_per_constraint: int = 220,
    smoothing_window: int = 3,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Calibrate per-model coherence thresholds from experiment logs.

    Returns the largest safe density below the first >10% post-peak quality drop.
    """
    import re
    from statistics import median

    def load_record(item: Path | dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            return item
        return json.loads(Path(item).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def model_name(record: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        return (
            record.get("model")
            or record.get("model_label")
            or record.get("metadata", {}).get("model")
            or record.get("metadata", {}).get("registry_model")
            or "unknown"
        )

    def directive_chars(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        metadata = record.get("metadata", {})
        return int(
            record.get("chars")
            or metadata.get("chars")
            or metadata.get("directive_chars")
            or record.get("prompt_length")
            or 0
        )

    def constraint_count(record: dict[str, Any], chars: int) -> int:
        metadata = record.get("metadata", {})
        if "constraint_count" in record:
            return int(record["constraint_count"])
        if "constraint_count" in metadata:
            return int(metadata["constraint_count"])

        prompt = (
            record.get("system_prompt")
            or metadata.get("system_prompt")
            or metadata.get("rendered_text")
            or ""
        )
        if prompt:
            markers = re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:\d+[.)]|[-*]|\w[\w .-]+:)", prompt)
            return max(1, len(markers))

        return max(1, round(chars / chars_per_constraint))

    def finding_count(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        metadata = record.get("metadata", {})
        if "findings_count" in metadata:
            return int(metadata["findings_count"])

        response = record.get("response", "")
        patterns = (
            len(re.findall(r"(?m)^FINDING_ID:", response)),
            len(re.findall(r'"finding_id"\s*:', response)),
            len(re.findall(r"(?m)^VERDICT:", response)),
        )
        return max(patterns) or 0

    def response_tokens(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        response = record.get("response", "")
        return max(len(response) // 4, 1)

    def smooth(values: list[float]) -> list[float]:
        if len(values) <= 1:
            return values[:]
        half = max(1, smoothing_window // 2)
        smoothed: list[float] = []
        for idx in range(len(values)):
            start = max(0, idx - half)
            end = min(len(values), idx + half + 1)
            smoothed.append(median(values[start:end]))
        return smoothed

    observations: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float]]] = {}

    for item in log_inputs:
        record = load_record(item)
        chars = directive_chars(record)
        if chars <= 0:
            continue

        constraints = constraint_count(record, chars)
        density = constraints / max(chars // 4, 1)
        quality = finding_count(record) / (response_tokens(record) / 1000.0)
        observations.setdefault(model_name(record), []).append((density, quality))

    budgets: dict[str, float] = {}

    for model, points in observations.items():
        if not points:
            continue

        points.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])
        densities = [density for density, _ in points]
        qualities = [quality for _, quality in points]
        smoothed_qualities = smooth(qualities)

        peak_idx = max(range(len(smoothed_qualities)), key=smoothed_qualities.__getitem__)
        peak_quality = smoothed_qualities[peak_idx]
        threshold = densities[-1]

        for idx in range(peak_idx + 1, len(densities)):
            if smoothed_qualities[idx] < peak_quality * 0.90:
                threshold = densities[max(peak_idx, idx - 1)]
                break

        budgets[model] = round(threshold, 6)

    return budgets
```

```python
def build_dispatch_directives(
    config: ModelConfig,
    *,
    task_domain: str,
    user_prompt: str,
    verified_facts: str = "",
    explicit_unknowns: str = "",
    adversarial_brief: str = "",
    interaction_surface: str = "",
) -> ComposedDirectiveSet:
    """Compose the per-dispatch directive set for one model call."""
    review_target = user_prompt.strip().splitlines()[0][:240] if user_prompt.strip() else "Dispatch task"
    return compose(
        task_domain=task_domain,
        model=config.registry_model,
        review_target=review_target,
        verified_facts=verified_facts,
        explicit_unknowns=explicit_unknowns,
        adversarial_brief=adversarial_brief,
        interaction_surface=interaction_surface,
    )


def dispatch_with_composition(
    config: ModelConfig,
    user_prompt: str,
    *,
    task_domain: str,
    verified_facts: str = "",
    explicit_unknowns: str = "",
    adversarial_brief: str = "",
    interaction_surface: str = "",
    use_output_schema: bool = False,
) -> tuple[str, ComposedDirectiveSet]:
    """Dispatch using a freshly composed directive set instead of a static file."""
    composed = build_dispatch_directives(
        config,
        task_domain=task_domain,
        user_prompt=user_prompt,
        verified_facts=verified_facts,
        explicit_unknowns=explicit_unknowns,
        adversarial_brief=adversarial_brief,
        interaction_surface=interaction_surface,
    )
    system_prompt = composed.rendered_text

    _log(
        f"Dispatching to {config.label} ({config.model_id}) via {config.api} "
        f"[CID={composed.cid}, domain={task_domain}]..."
    )

    if config.api == "openrouter":
        response = call_openrouter(
            model_id=config.model_id,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            user_prompt=user_prompt,
            max_tokens=config.max_tokens,
            timeout=config.timeout,
            max_retries=config.max_retries,
            backoff_base=config.backoff_base,
        )
    elif config.api == "codex_exec":
        response = call_codex(
            user_prompt=user_prompt,
            cdsfl_directives=system_prompt,
            timeout=config.timeout,
            max_retries=config.max_retries,
            use_output_schema=use_output_schema,
        )
    elif config.api == "google":
        response = call_gemini(
            model_id=config.model_id,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            user_prompt=user_prompt,
            max_tokens=config.max_tokens,
            timeout=config.timeout,
            max_retries=config.max_retries,
            backoff_base=config.backoff_base,
        )
    elif config.api == "deepseek":
        response = call_deepseek(
            model_id=config.model_id,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            user_prompt=user_prompt,
            max_tokens=config.max_tokens,
            timeout=config.timeout,
            max_retries=config.max_retries,
            backoff_base=config.backoff_base,
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown API type: {config.api}")

    return response, composed


def dispatch(
    config: ModelConfig,
    user_prompt: str,
    *,
    task_domain: str,
    verified_facts: str = "",
    explicit_unknowns: str = "",
    adversarial_brief: str = "",
    interaction_surface: str = "",
    use_output_schema: bool = False,
) -> str:
    """Backward-compatible wrapper when the caller only needs response text."""
    response, _ = dispatch_with_composition(
        config,
        user_prompt,
        task_domain=task_domain,
        verified_facts=verified_facts,
        explicit_unknowns=explicit_unknowns,
        adversarial_brief=adversarial_brief,
        interaction_surface=interaction_surface,
        use_output_schema=use_output_schema,
    )
    return response


def run_preflight(config: ExperimentConfig) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Run identity and compliance checks on all models. Returns results dict."""
    results: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for model in config.models:
        if model.role == "collator":
            continue

        _log(f"\n=== Preflight: {model.label} ===")
        result: dict[str, Any] = {"identity_pass": False, "compliance_pass": False}
        identity_composed: ComposedDirectiveSet | None = None
        compliance_composed: ComposedDirectiveSet | None = None

        try:
            identity_response, identity_composed = dispatch_with_composition(
                model,
                IDENTITY_PROMPT,
                task_domain="cross-domain",
                verified_facts="This is a preflight identity check only.",
                interaction_surface="Single-turn identity verification.",
            )
            result["identity_response"] = identity_response
            response_lower = identity_response.lower()

            checks = IDENTITY_CHECKS.get(model.label, {})
            accept_terms = checks.get("accept", [])
            reject_terms = checks.get("reject", [])

            has_accept = any(term in response_lower for term in accept_terms)
            has_reject = any(term in response_lower for term in reject_terms)

            if has_accept and not has_reject:
                result["identity_pass"] = True
                _log("  Identity: PASS")
            else:
                _log(f"  Identity: FAIL (accept={has_accept}, reject={has_reject})")
                _log(f"  Response: {identity_response[:200]}")
        except Exception as e:
            result["identity_error"] = str(e)
            _log(f"  Identity: ERROR — {str(e)[:200]}")

        if result["identity_pass"]:
            try:
                compliance_response, compliance_composed = dispatch_with_composition(
                    model,
                    COMPLIANCE_PROMPT,
                    task_domain="mathematics",
                    verified_facts="In Euclidean geometry, triangle interior angles sum to 180 degrees.",
                    interaction_surface="Single-turn structured compliance verification.",
                    use_output_schema=(model.label == "Codex"),
                )
                result["compliance_response"] = compliance_response
                response_upper = compliance_response.upper()

                found_fields = [f for f in STRUCTURED_FIELDS if f in response_upper]
                if len(found_fields) >= 4:
                    result["compliance_pass"] = True
                    _log(f"  Compliance: PASS ({len(found_fields)}/6 fields)")
                else:
                    _log(f"  Compliance: FAIL (only {len(found_fields)}/6 fields: {found_fields})")
            except Exception as e:
                result["compliance_error"] = str(e)
                _log(f"  Compliance: ERROR — {str(e)[:200]}")

        results[model.label] = result
        save_output(
            config.logs_dir,
            "preflight",
            model.label,
            IDENTITY_PROMPT,
            result.get("identity_response", "ERROR"),
            metadata={
                "identity_pass": result["identity_pass"],
                "compliance_pass": result["compliance_pass"],
                "composer_cid": identity_composed.cid if identity_composed else None,
                "composer_manifest": identity_composed.manifest if identity_composed else None,
                "compliance_cid": compliance_composed.cid if compliance_composed else None,
                "compliance_manifest": compliance_composed.manifest if compliance_composed else None,
            },
        )

    return results
```
